content.text:
**Finding: TRANSITION — compliant (preferred level).**

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") satisfies every preferred element:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Applies on expiry or termination | 11.1 — "Upon expiry or termination for any reason", no cause-based carve-out |
| Up to six months' assistance | 11.1 |
| Charged at rates | 11.1 — rates in the expiring Order Form |
| Return within 30 days | 11.2 |
| Standard machine-readable format | 11.2 — "complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format" |
| Certified deletion after return | 11.3 — deletion "[a]fter Customer confirms successful return", certified by an authorized officer |

Two variances are favourable to us and were noted rather than redlined: pricing is fixed to the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates, and the 30-day return clock runs from our request, keeping timing under our control. Sections 10, 15 and 16 contain no conflicting deletion or retention mechanic (16.3 expressly defers to Sections 11 and 15), and 11.2 additionally bars Vendor from withholding data over a fee dispute. No redline proposed.
